surfaces.greenOwnership: actual fractured object or authored light-eaten edge; never the whole floor

presentation.surfaceVisibility: native finite fog: only erosion/void blocks sight; local material shading never changes tactical visibility
presentation.occlusion: explicit solid role masks foreground; walkable relief never clips actors
